diagnosis: The view retrieves DataExportRequest by export_id from the URL and dispatches a Celery task to bundle personal data. Because the view fails to check that export_job.user == request.user, any user can trigger processing and access output paths of other users' GDPR archives.
exploit_request:
POST /api/privacy/gdpr/exports/3810/start/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
